changes.before: Supports early-career researchers trained in computer science, machine learning, mathematics, and quantitative disciplines who apply computational methods to biological and life sciences questions during their transition to university faculty.
changes.after: Five-year, $560,000 transition award for interdisciplinary biological research using non-biological methods. In the 2027 cycle, only LOI applicants invited by November 13 may submit a full proposal by January 11, 2027; the LOI window closed August 14, 2026.

before: Hold a PhD in computer science, physics, mathematics, or engineering
Must have at least 12 months and not more than 48 months of postdoctoral experience
Must not hold or have accepted a tenure-track faculty appointment at time of application
after: PhD in mathematics, physics, chemistry, computer science, statistics, or engineering; biological-field PhDs may qualify with prior approval and demonstrated quantitative/computational expertise
At least 12 and no more than 60 months of postdoctoral research by the invited full-proposal deadline; first-author peer-reviewed publication required
Must not hold or have accepted a tenure-track assistant-professor appointment; research must use non-biological approaches to address biological-science questions
Eligible applicants are U.S. or Canadian citizens, permanent residents, or temporary residents with qualifying work authorization; grant recipient institution must be a U.S. or Canadian nonprofit

changes.before: Supports foundational and applied computer science research in key technical focus areas (such as quantum computing, security, and AI), pairing academic PIs with Google research sponsors.
changes.after: Google’s 2026 global call focused on early fault-tolerant quantum algorithms and applications, and quantum-computing security. The call opened June 26 and closed August 7; proposal decisions are scheduled for October 30. Award amounts are not specified on the overview page.

findings: BWF CASI 2027 LOI closed August 14; January 11 full-proposal deadline is for invitees only; program page states applications are not open.
Google Academic Research Awards 2026 call ran June 26–August 7, focused on two quantum research areas, and schedules decisions October 30. The overview does not publish award amounts.

Google Research Scholar Program page lists 2020–2025 recipients and uses past-tense program wording; the current faculty page lists Google Academic Research Awards and other programs instead. No 2026 Scholar call was found.
